text:
Type: enamelled metal dome pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table, a kitchen island or a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: industrial, retro, Scandinavian
Materials: lacquered metal shade with a glossy finish, black fabric cord, matching ceiling cup
Colors: warm off-white cream, black cord, white inner shade
Shape: wide flared dome shade with a narrow neck, hangs on a long thin cord, clean rounded outline, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: soft, friendly, workshop-inspired, warm
Goes with: light wood tables, white or beige walls, black accents; Scandinavian, farmhouse or industrial kitchens

product.name: FOTO
product.description: Gives a directed light; good for lighting up for example dining tables or bar tops.
